text.en: Visitors praise the salon team and highlight employees such as Peyton and Linda for their friendly, attentive support. Staff demonstrate how to operate the self-wash equipment, assist with newly adopted rescue dogs, and provide skilled grooming cuts, although one client reported confusion regarding morning opening hours.

Clients consistently compliment the spotless condition of the washroom, praising the waist-high tubs, heated towels, and accessible bathing supplies. Pet owners find the self-wash area comfortable and well supplied with grooming solutions, making bath time manageable even with energetic or large dogs.

title.en: Fresh coats and skilled haircut styling

text.en: Dog owners report excellent outcomes from both self-serve wash sessions and full styling appointments with groomer Linda. Reviewers note that dogs leave with soft, sweet-smelling fur and neatly trimmed coats, with extra touches such as ear cleaning and nail clipping appreciated by regular visitors.

q.en: How do the self-service wash stations operate?

a.en: Stations feature waist-high tubs, warm water sprayers, professional shampoos, clean towels, and drying equipment.

q.en: Do staff assist with first-time self-wash visitors?

a.en: Yes, team members show clients how to use the shower hoses, rinse equipment, and specialized cleaning liquids.
Yes, pet parents mention signing up for monthly wash memberships to maintain regular hygiene routines.

q.en: What full grooming services are offered?

a.en: Stylists provide full haircuts, nail trims, ear cleaning, and de-shedding baths tailored to specific dog breeds.
